summary: This 4-day Seoul itinerary is tailored for K-POP fans and shopping enthusiasts, covering the trendiest districts. You'll explore the upscale boutiques and K-POP culture of Gangnam and Sinsa, dive into the vibrant youth fashion and K-POP stores of Hongdae and Yeonnam, discover unique local designs and cafes in Seongsu, and enjoy major shopping centers and scenic spots in Jamsil.
